sourceName: Surname coverage audit over Mundus country anchors
licenseName: Derived metadata from Mundus-reviewed surname and Natural Earth assets
version: coverage schema 1; sovereign country audit with manual observations
attribution: Coverage state is an audit result over 195 sovereign-country codes and the complete Mundus country anchor inventory; no-source anchors have no map wordmark.
transformations: Join surname records to the complete generated country anchor inventory
Classify each anchor country as rank-one, source-listed, manual-observation, or no-source
Publish a separate sovereignCountries audit keyed by ISO2 so 195 sovereign states can be checked without counting territories or duplicate geometry anchors
missingValuePolicy: No-source countries remain explicitly listed and are not assigned a surname or numeric ranking.
boundaryPolicy: Coverage status does not imply a unified global ranking; sovereign coverage is an availability audit, not a claim that every observation is rank-one.
